richiami.difetto: The 6 mm² cable cross-sections of the charging boosters may be too small to safely carry fault currents which could cause the cables to overload and overheat potentially leading to a fire.The charging booster’s wiring will be replaced and a pre-fuse will be fitted.
richiami.rimedio: The charging booster’s wiring will be replaced and a pre-fuse will be fitted.
